name: WebChannel
description: Self-hosted web chat channel plugin for OpenClaw.

schema.description: WebChannel config (OpenClaw multi-account model). The channel-level (flat) fields are the shared base AND the implicit "default" account; named accounts live under `accounts.<accountId>` and inherit the channel-level base. Acquisition identity (tenant/accountId/saas.baseUrl) and credentials are set via 'openclaw channels add --channel webchannel'.

accounts.description: Per-account overrides keyed by accountId (channels.webchannel.accounts.<id>). Each account inherits the channel-level (flat) fields as a shared base; account fields override. By design the per-account leaf schema is NOT enumerated here (additionalProperties:true / unvalidated) — it mirrors the channel-level fields; validating it twice would couple the two trees. Named accounts are created by 'openclaw channels add --channel webchannel --account <id>'.

tenant.description: Deployment tenant identifier (acquisition identity). Set via 'openclaw channels add --channel webchannel --tenant <t>' (or the mapped --url flag).

storageRoot.description: Absolute common local base directory for tuple-scoped credentials and conversation keys. Relative paths are rejected rather than resolved against the process working directory. Each account uses an opaque namespace derived from the exact (tenant, accountId). This does not change the meaning of an exact credentialPath API override.

saas.description: SaaS issuer settings for enrolled-mode acquisition.

baseUrl.description: SaaS issuer base URL (the /api/enroll + /api/poll endpoints are derived from it). Set via 'openclaw channels add --channel webchannel --saas-base-url <url>' (or the mapped --base-url flag). Env override (legacy, config wins): WEBCHANNEL_SAAS_BASE_URL.

strategy.description: jwt is required. anonymous is REMOVED and reaches a startup migration error.

ticketParam.description: REMOVED — load-time migration error. Gateway direct WebSocket ticket authentication no longer exists; reset this channel with `openclaw channels add --channel webchannel`.

requirePoP.description: Require Proof-of-Possession at the NATS register hop. Default true (secure-by-default): a verified bootstrap JWT with no pop_jwk is rejected before any peer is registered. Set false to restore legacy optional-PoP behavior (dev only).

jwksUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the IdP's JWKS endpoint. Exactly one of jwksUrl, jwks, or jwksFile is required.

jwks.description: Inline JWKS document (parsed object with a `keys` array). Exactly one of jwksUrl, jwks, or jwksFile is required.

jwksFile.description: Filesystem path to a JWKS file baked into the deployment. Exactly one of jwksUrl, jwks, or jwksFile is required.

issuer.description: Expected `iss` claim. Tokens with a different iss are rejected (constant-time compare).

audience.description: REMOVED — delete this key. JWT aud is always the runtime accountId; every JSON value reaches a targeted migration error.

clockSkew.description: Allowed clock-skew leeway in seconds when checking exp. Default 60.

reasoning.description: Whether the agent's reasoning/thinking stream is delivered to browser peers. Defaults to true when the key is OMITTED; set it to boolean false to turn the lane off. A persisted explicit session /reasoning off also vetoes delivery. Deliberately carries NO schema default: core hydrates defaults into the stored config, so declaring one here would write the key into every deployment and the omitted-means-on default could never be reached. Note the "on"/"off" strings that capabilities.typing accepts are rejected by this channel-level schema; deliberately unvalidated named-account leaves fail closed at runtime. Enabling it is necessary but NOT sufficient: the agent's own thinking level must also be something other than "off", which channel config cannot force.

reasoningDurable.description: Whether the agent's reasoning/thinking content is PERSISTED to this plugin's delivery journal on disk, as message plaintext. Defaults to FALSE when the key is OMITTED; set it to boolean true to opt in. Deliberately SEPARATE from capabilities.reasoning, which governs the ephemeral live lane and defaults to true: #113's default-ON was a decision to render a volatile live lane, and it does not inherit to a decision to permanently record plaintext to disk. Reasoning routinely restates tool output, file contents and the user's own prompt; nothing ages out of the journal yet (#299); and #242 half 1 has no client that can read these rows back, so opting in currently buys storage with no user-visible benefit. Carries NO schema default for the same reason capabilities.reasoning does not: core hydrates defaults into the stored config, so declaring one would write the key into every deployment. Deliberately unvalidated named-account leaves fail closed at runtime. Enabling it is necessary but NOT sufficient, and the dependency runs one way: durability records the SAME lane the live stream carries, so if the LANE never opens — capabilities.reasoning set to false, or a persisted session /reasoning off — no reasoning frame is produced and NO ROW IS WRITTEN, silently: the empty-lane diagnostic only watches lanes that opened. "Record it but do not show it" is therefore not a configuration this key can express. An agent thinking level of "off" also yields no rows, but that case DOES surface the #113 empty-lane warning, because there the lane opens and simply receives nothing.

nats.description: Agent↔NATS connection. Authenticated enrollment and register-hop peer admission are required; static BYO-NATS serving returns in P0-3.

url.description: NATS WebSocket URL (ws://… / wss://…). For enrolled mode the SaaS-delivered relay URL wins; this and WEBCHANNEL_NATS_URL are overrides.

devOpen.description: REMOVED — startup migration error. Unauthenticated NATS mode no longer exists.

admission.description: register-hop is required. auto is REMOVED and reaches a startup migration error.

credentials.description: Credential source — HOW the agent authenticates to NATS (orthogonal to peer admission).

mode.description: enrolled is the supported mode. static is rejected until P0-3; open is REMOVED and reaches a startup migration error.

userJwt.description: Static mode: NATS user JWT. Env override: WEBCHANNEL_NATS_USER_JWT. Use { "env": "VAR" } rather than inlining the secret.

userSeed.description: Static mode: NATS user NKEY seed ("SU…"). Env override: WEBCHANNEL_NATS_USER_SEED. Use { "env": "VAR" } rather than inlining the secret.

credsFile.description: Static mode: path to a standard NATS .creds file (contains the user JWT + NKEY seed). Env override: WEBCHANNEL_NATS_CREDS.

saasBaseUrl.description: Enrolled mode: SaaS issuer base URL (the /api/enroll and /api/poll endpoints are derived from it). Env override: WEBCHANNEL_SAAS_BASE_URL.

auth.strategy.label: Auth strategy
auth.strategy.help: Browser connections require JWT verification plus Proof-of-Possession over the authenticated NATS register hop. anonymous is removed and causes a targeted startup migration error.

auth.jwt.jwksUrl.label: JWKS URL
auth.jwt.jwksUrl.help: HTTPS URL of the IdP's JWKS endpoint (e.g. https://your-tenant.auth0.com/.well-known/jwks.json). The gateway fetches and caches it with a 5-minute TTL. DERIVED at runtime as `<saas.baseUrl>/.well-known/jwks.json` when no key source is configured; set this (or jwks/jwksFile) only to override. Exactly one of jwksUrl, jwks, or jwksFile is used.

auth.jwt.jwks.label: Inline JWKS
auth.jwt.jwks.help: Inline JWKS document (object with `keys: [...]`). Useful for offline deployments and tests. Exactly one of jwksUrl, jwks, or jwksFile is required.

auth.jwt.jwksFile.label: JWKS file path
auth.jwt.jwksFile.help: Filesystem path to a JWKS JSON file baked into the deployment. The file is re-read on every refresh (5-minute TTL). Exactly one of jwksUrl, jwks, or jwksFile is required.

auth.jwt.issuer.label: Issuer (iss)
auth.jwt.issuer.help: Expected `iss` claim. Tokens whose iss does not match (constant-time compare) are rejected. DERIVED at runtime from the SaaS base URL (`issuer == saas.baseUrl`) when omitted; set this only to pin a different issuer (proxy / custom-domain).

auth.jwt.audience.label: Audience (removed)
auth.jwt.audience.help: REMOVED — delete auth.jwt.audience. The plugin always expects JWT aud to contain its runtime accountId. This value is never used as verifier configuration.

auth.jwt.clockSkew.label: Clock skew (sec)
auth.jwt.clockSkew.help: Allowed clock-skew leeway in seconds when checking exp. Default 60.

streaming.mode.label: Streaming mode
streaming.mode.help: Progress draft mode: "off" | "partial" | "block" | "progress". Use "partial" to stream the answer text into a single updating Working… draft that becomes the answer (also carries tool progress lines); "progress" streams tool progress lines only — the answer arrives atomically.

execApprovals.enabled.label: Native exec approvals
execApprovals.enabled.help: Render native [Allow once] [Allow always] [Deny] buttons in the chat UI when a tool/exec needs approval. true|"auto" enables; false disables. Approvers are required (see execApprovals.approvers) — enabling without approvers yields no native approval surface.

execApprovals.approvers.label: Exec approver peer ids
execApprovals.approvers.help: Verified webchannel peer ids allowed to resolve an exec approval via the widget. Falls back to commands.ownerAllowFrom when unset. Peer ids come from your verifier (src/auth.js peerId).

capabilities.inlineButtons.label: Inline buttons
capabilities.inlineButtons.help: Where to render inline approval buttons: "all" | "dm" | "group" | "allowlist" | "off".

capabilities.typing.label: Typing indicator
capabilities.typing.help: Whether the server pushes a native "Bot is typing…" frame at the start of each turn. Default "on"; set to "off" to disable (typing is then never emitted, regardless of inbound flow).

capabilities.reasoning.label: Reasoning stream
capabilities.reasoning.help: Whether the agent's reasoning/thinking stream is delivered to browser peers. Default true when omitted; set boolean false to turn the lane off. A persisted explicit session /reasoning off also vetoes delivery. This key is a boolean: malformed channel-level values are rejected, while deliberately unvalidated named-account values fail closed at runtime. Note this alone is not enough: the agent's thinking level must also be other than "off", or the lane stays empty.

capabilities.reasoningDurable.label: Persist reasoning to disk
capabilities.reasoningDurable.help: Whether the agent's reasoning/thinking content is written to this plugin's delivery journal on disk as plaintext. Default false when omitted; set boolean true to opt in. This is NOT capabilities.reasoning — that key controls the live lane and defaults to true. Rendering a volatile live lane and permanently recording plaintext are separate decisions. Nothing ages out of the journal yet, and no client can read these rows back until #242 half 2, so leave it off unless you specifically want the record. Necessary but NOT sufficient: durability records the same lane the live stream carries. If the lane never opens — capabilities.reasoning false, or a session /reasoning off — no frames are produced and no rows are written, with no warning, because the empty-lane diagnostic only watches lanes that opened. Setting this to true while the lane is off records nothing. (An agent thinking level of "off" also produces no rows, but that one does warn: the lane opens and receives nothing.)

history.enabled.label: History pagination
history.enabled.help: Whether the server pushes a snapshot of the last N messages on connect, and responds to `load_history` requests from the widget. Default `true`. When disabled, the widget shows no hydrated history on reconnect.

history.limit.label: History snapshot size
history.limit.help: Maximum number of messages sent in the initial on-connect history snapshot. Default 50.

history.pageSize.label: History page size
history.pageSize.help: Default page size when the widget asks for older messages via `load_history`. Default 50.

cliAddOptions.description: WebChannel: SaaS issuer base URL for enrolled-mode credential acquisition (config-time). Maps to channels.webchannel.<account>.saas.baseUrl.
WebChannel: deployment tenant identifier. Maps to channels.webchannel.<account>.tenant.
